items.title: feat(fleet-queue): surface at_cap_queued in queue health (#6528)
items.body: Fixes the surfacing branch of #6528 (criteria 2/3). Queue task 11461, routed by triage task 11211. ## What `fleet queue health` could not distinguish "queued and claimable" from "queued but every task at its attempt cap" — the dead-in-queue state behind #6528 read as ordinary backlog, and a claim coming back empty was undiagnosable from health output. The Turso health verb (`pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-queue/src/turso_queue.rs`) now computes, per queue, **at_cap_queued**: tasks with `status='queued' AND attempts >= max_attempts` — exactly the set the claim query can never return (claim requires `attempts < max_attempts`). When `at_cap_queued == queued > 0`, nothing in that queue is claimable. ## How - Separate grouped query in `verb_health` (the status GROUP BY cannot express the attempts predicate), folded into the health rows by the pure helper `apply_at_cap_queued`. - The zeroed health-row template is factored into `health_entry`, which now includes `at_cap_queued` right after `queued`. The client renders the table from row keys, so the new column appears with no client change. The PostgREST health path reads `repo_queue_health?select=*`, so it will surface the same field if the view gains it; the live backend is Turso, implemented here. ## Tests `cargo test -p fleet-queue --features queue-broker --lib` — 85 passed, including two new tests: - `health_entry_defaults_at_cap_queued_to_zero` - `at_cap_fold_covers_zero_claimable_and_partial_queues` — the #6528 fixture: a queue with queued=3 / at_cap=3 (zero claimable), a partial queue (5/2), and a queue with none at cap (stays 0). Out of scope (unchanged, per the packet): claimant launch (#6533, #6865), claim semantics, attempt counting, per-task cap raises. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
